notes: Versioned owner-approved evaluation set. Covers normal and specialist dental questions, off-domain requests, diagnosis/prescription, emergencies, prompt injection, secret exfiltration, harmful requests, ambiguity, identity override, adversarial retrieved-content attacks and citation-required cases. Deterministic tests validate routing and response contracts; semantic model quality requires a separate provider-backed evaluation. The fake provider is not evidence of production-model accuracy.
